question: Find the display name of the owner of the post that has the highest view count among all posts created in 2011 and has no comments.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2011'
  AND p."XCL_026" NOT IN (SELECT "XCL_006" FROM comments)
ORDER BY p."XCL_030" DESC
LIMIT 1
